cover.coreProposition: Execution competence and trustworthy evidentiary judgment are separate acceptance states; consequential knowledge work should require observed challenge evidence for controls, robustness, falsification and bounded generalization before a polished result becomes organizational authority.
cover.visualMetaphor: A polished crystalline report passes through an indigo evidence ring while a second cyan challenge ring tests its stability and reveals one restrained amber fracture.
cover.semanticObject: A luminous report crystal held between an evidence ring and a separate challenge ring
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with deep navy space, a central clear crystal, distinct cyan and violet rings, one restrained amber stress line, dimensional depth, and generous negative space
